spec.expr:
max by (name, model, version) (
  label_join(label_join(label_join(
    fritz_uptime_seconds_total,
    "name", " ", "friendly_name"),
    "model", "", "modelname"),
    "version", "", "softwareversion")
)
or
max by (name, model, version) (
  label_join(label_join(label_join(
    node_uname_info,
    "name", " ", "nodename"),
    "model", " ", "sysname"),
    "version", " ", "release", "version")
)
